unit.why: A brief anecdote: Heaven gave the Besht a choice of town, and he chose Medzhybizh because fish for Shabbat were easy to find there. It is told to illustrate a point about Shabbat fish.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a run of items on fish for Shabbat ('מענין דגים') that begins at the end of the previous division and continues into the next.

stories.start_quote: ב) סיפר לענין דגים ששכיחים להימשך
stories.summary_en: The Baal Shem Tov was given a choice from Heaven to live in Nemirov, Medzhybizh or a third town, and he chose Medzhybizh because fish were common there and easy to obtain for Shabbat.

quotes: ששכיחים שם דגים נקל לו להשיגם לש״ק
tags.why: The choice turns on obtaining fish for Shabbat.

quotes: שמן השמים נתנו לו ברירה לדור
tags.why: Heaven communicates a choice to the Besht.
